claim_text: Atlas Mining controls a licensed copper asset (Exploitation License No. 353294, 15.36 km², valid to 02/10/2034) in the Isseksi / Beni Mellal-Khénifra context.
restricted_wording: License copy, coordinates and official holder name under NDA / restricted legal review only.
risk_if_overstated: Legal exposure if holder name, boundaries or obligations are misstated before counsel confirmation.

claim_text: The project benefits from Environmental Approval No. CRI/24/102.
allowed_public_wording: The project benefits from an environmental approval reference, while operations remain subject to detailed compliance review and permitting.
restricted_wording: Approval document and obligations under NDA review.
risk_if_overstated: Regulatory exposure if presented as full operating compliance.

claim_text: A May 2025 field campaign completed ~232 m of trenching across 7 trenches and submitted 29 samples to AFRILAB.
allowed_public_wording: The project has moved beyond paper stage: trenching, sampling and laboratory assays are completed.

claim_text: Selected AFRILAB samples returned high copper grades up to 9.65% Cu.
allowed_public_wording: Selected high-grade copper assays up to 9.65% Cu — selected-sample evidence, not average project grade.
restricted_wording: Full sample tables under NDA review.
risk_if_overstated: SEVERE — implying average grade from selected samples would constitute material overclaim.
recommended_badge: Selected-sample assay — not average project grade

claim_text: The A.I.P.S orientation study states a preliminary estimate of 2.3 Mt at 1.8% Cu.
allowed_public_wording: A preliminary orientation estimate of 2.3 Mt at 1.8% Cu — requiring validation; not a certified resource or reserve.
restricted_wording: Study extracts under NDA; assumption register restricted-technical.
risk_if_overstated: SEVERE — presenting as certified resource/reserve would be a prohibited claim.

claim_text: The A.I.P.S study proposes an 800 t/day sulfide flotation plant fed by 4 open pits at ~200 t/day each.
allowed_public_wording: A preliminary 800 t/day processing scenario — the initial industrial reference case, not a final plant decision.
risk_if_overstated: High — premature plant commitment language would distort the pilot-first pathway.
recommended_badge: Preliminary processing scenario — not final plant decision

claim_text: The A.I.P.S study states preliminary CAPEX of 124.4M MAD HT (mine 3.41 / plant 96.06 / infrastructure 24.93).
allowed_public_wording: Preliminary CAPEX framework of 124.4M MAD HT — not final capital cost, not the development ceiling.
restricted_wording: Component breakdown under NDA; sensitivity work restricted-technical.
recommended_badge: Preliminary CAPEX orientation — subject to engineering update

claim_text: The orientation model indicates annual gains in a 162–406M MAD range.
restricted_wording: Internal only until the financial model is corrected and updated; linked to AIPS-013/014.
risk_if_overstated: SEVERE — presenting as bankable cash flow is prohibited; figure feeds a known material-balance review item.
recommended_badge: Preliminary model output — not bankable cash flow

claim_text: The study scenario includes 225,000 t/year optimal tonnage and a 22,050 t/year concentrate at 28.40% Cu with ~89.78–90% recovery.
allowed_public_wording: (Qualified review and above.) Production scheduling scenario, subject to material-balance review and flotation test work.
restricted_wording: Material-balance review item (AIPS-014) tracked openly in the assumption register.
risk_if_overstated: High — these figures feed the known arithmetic review item.

claim_text: Entry & Validation Access requires a USD 150,000 Non-Refundable Entry Fee payable to Atlas Mining.
allowed_public_wording: USD 150,000 Non-Refundable Entry & Validation Access fee — structured access; not a license purchase, technology fee, equity investment, refundable deposit, production right, or guaranteed operating agreement.
restricted_wording: Full term structure at qualified review and above.
risk_if_overstated: SEVERE — mischaracterizing the fee creates legal and reputational exposure.

claim_text: The license is not being sold; the standard offer is structured operating entry and validation access.
allowed_public_wording: Atlas Mining preserves license control; any transfer, equity, or operating right is separately negotiated and documented.
risk_if_overstated: SEVERE — implying license sale contradicts the core commercial architecture.

claim_text: The ATLAS Intelligent Copper Targeting System is an independent decision-support layer (Akanil technology structure), separate from the entry fee.
allowed_public_wording: An optional, independent digital validation layer that reduces blind exploration and supports pilot-feed definition. It does not replace geologists, engineers, labs, legal review, or feasibility studies.
restricted_wording: Commercial terms for system adoption negotiated separately.
risk_if_overstated: High — bundling the system with the fee breaks a binding separation rule.

claim_text: The license may hold upside beyond the preliminary orientation case (larger mineralized system hypothesis; possible Cu/Zn extension; additional zones).
allowed_public_wording: Potential upside beyond the preliminary orientation case — subject to geophysics, drilling, and resource validation; not yet resource-classified.
restricted_wording: No new tonnage/grade figures may be attached to the upside case.
risk_if_overstated: SEVERE — inventing upside tonnage/grade would be fabrication.

claim_text: After validation, the project may support staged industrial development: selective pilot → modular processing → staged production → plant decision → long-term operating agreement.
allowed_public_wording: Expansion case — staged development pathway requiring feasibility and engineering validation.
recommended_badge: Expansion case — requires feasibility and engineering validation

claim_text: IP/Resistivity geophysics is recommended to define depth and continuity of mineralization; DD/RC drilling contractors have been approached.
allowed_public_wording: Geophysics is the recommended next validation step, with drilling pathways already scoped.
